text_block_list.text:
The "Fukuryu Stakes." The day of the open 
dirt race—chosen deliberately over the 
"Satsuki Sho"—had arrived.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Hey Trainer, I decided not to enter the 
Satsuki Sho, but..."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
What about the next Japan Derby? Do you 
still want to run in it after all?
choice_data_list: You're right. Because it's a special race.
Yeah. Because it's a special race.

text_block_list.text:
It's not a race just anyone can enter. And 
Copano Rickey, regardless of aptitudes, is 
an Umamusume capable of meeting the entry 
conditions.

If the timing works out for everything— 
running in the Japanese Derby is 
definitely something I'd like to consider.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Understood. Then, keeping that in mind, 
I'll go run!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(The qi is... weak? The qi of the running 
Umamusume, and even the qi of the 
spectators...)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(It's so quiet it's hard to read the room. 
Still, there's bound to be a clue here to 
help decide between turf or dirt.)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(—Silence. Yes, even this silence is the 
neighing of a dragon. The dragon beneath 
the earth is trying to tell me something!)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Even if I don't stand out now, if I work 
hard, someday they'll see me! I'll become 
famous!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Turf really is the main attraction of 
racing. I just couldn't let go of that 
feeling.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
ââ!! I see. Could that be what this 
means?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"If this assessment is correct, then the 
path I must take is—"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
—I don't know yet. But if I can run a 
truly meaningful race here...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
—The dragon will definitely show its face. 
It'll point me in the auspicious 
direction! All right!!
